BP: Built automated pre/post-load validation and reporting infrastructure tracking record counts and error rates, accelerating business sign-off and enabling a controlled go-live.

BP: Developed complex SQL (CTEs, stored procedures) to derive and transform source data and cleanse hidden/special characters; delivered self-service reports (duplicate analysis, positive list, config comparison).

Corning Inc. (Manufacturing, Feb 2022 – Dec 2023): Built SQL data-quality reports and monitoring dashboards; wrote Python for automated profiling and anomaly detection; created reusable cleansing/validation utilities and automated alerting.
